title: PINK MALL Social Intelligence Contract
description: Governs the machine-readable contract 04 document. Exact membership is proved with contains rules rather than uniqueItems, which forbids duplicates but says nothing about which members are present.

status.description: Lifecycle provenance and location-neutral. Never a canonicality test.

tiers.description: Tier order is carried by priorityClass and rankedAbove. No number appears anywhere in this block, by design: a rank expressed as arithmetic is a weight, and no numeric weighting is authorised.

actions.description: Owned by contract 03. Exact membership is proved here so contract 04 cannot quietly add, drop or rename an action.

permittedTargets.description: Exact membership per referring kind, unchanged from the reviewed base. RECOMMENDATION and CREATIVE_MECHANISM_ASSESSMENT appear in no mayReference list: nothing may rest on a proposal, and widening the target set is not part of a resolution repair.

enforceableByJsonSchemaAlone.description: Draft 2020-12 has no keyword for cross-record resolution or for uniqueness by an arbitrary identifier property. Stating that here keeps the contract from implying a guarantee the schema cannot give.

publicRepositoryInstancePersistenceAllow.description: Standing policy: a real runtime snapshot is never persisted in this public repository. Not a record of what the repository contains at any moment, and synthetic fixtures are not runtime instances.
